title: Faster Than Strong - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Faster Than Strong in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Faster Than Strong is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Favours Speed over raw damage.

sections.title: How to Get Faster Than Strong
Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
